                  [32m'const amountType = type("0 < number < 10000").narrow((val, ctx) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const str = val.toString();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (str.includes("e") || str.includes("E")) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        ctx.error("must have at most 2 decimal places");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        return false;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const parts = str.split(".");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (parts.length > 1 && parts[1].length > 2) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        ctx.error("must have at most 2 decimal places");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        return false;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
